## 🏠 What is this project?

The main goal is to analyze patterns in U.S. real estate data through:

- ✔️ Data cleaning and preparation 
- ✔️ Clustering techniques 
- ✔️ Statistical and geospatial visualizations  
- ✔️ Interactive maps based on real coordinates
